cash_drawer_movement.observation: Refund does NOT create a CashMovement ledger row directly — instead it creates a mirror OrderPayment (CASH mode, amount=-11.00, paid_at=now) which Z-aggregation picks up via total_by_method. Net cash for the day in next Z = parent_payments (+) − mirror_payments (-).
cash_drawer_movement.nf525_compliance: CORRECT — Z aggregates via order_payments per mode (verified F.10.2 below), so cash drawer reconciliation is byproduct of normal Z run. The cash drawer SESSION ledger (CashMovement) is NOT touched directly; reconciliation flows through Z's total_by_method.
